_doc.about: List section headings, run by shared/src/sections.spec.ts and Android :core SectionFixturesTest (America/New_York; now and date are local wall times). Days are calendar days, so a 23- or 25-hour day around a clock change is still one day.
_doc.past: pastSection(date, now): Today (also future dates), Yesterday, This week (weeks start Sunday), This month, then one section per month for this year and last year (key month:YYYY-M; title "October", or "December 2025" for last year), then one section per year before that (key year:YYYY, title "2024").
_doc.future: futureSection(date, now): Today on now's day, Tonight from 18:00 on it, Tomorrow, then "This Saturday" (key day:Saturday) for the rest of this week (weeks start Sunday), Next week for the week after, then one section per month (key month:YYYY-M; title "November", or "January 2027" in another year). A date already past is due now, so it goes where now does: Today, or Tonight once now is 18:00 or later.
